252100Z POSITION NEAR 20.2N 109.8E.
25AUG26. TROPICAL DEPRESSION 18W (NARRA), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY
216 NM EAST-SOUTHEAST OF HANOI, VIETNAM, HAS TRACKED
NORTHEASTWARD AT 08 KNOTS OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS. ANIMATED ENHANCED
INFRARED (EIR) IMAGERY REVEALS THAT TROPICAL DEPRESSION (TD) 19W
(NARRA) HAS BECOME UNIDENTIFIABLE AS A CIRCULATION WITHIN A HOSTILE
ENVIRONMENT DEVOID OF CONVECTION AND DOMINATED BY VERY HIGH
(35-40 KTS) VERTICAL WIND SHEAR. 19W IS ALSO UNIDENTIFIABLE IN THE
COMPOSITE RADAR COVERING THE AREA. NARRA IS FORECAST TO CONTINUE
TRACKING GENERALLY NORTHEASTWARD ALONG THE COAST OF HAINAN
WHILE FURTHER UNRAVELING, EVENTUALLY MOVING OVER MAINLAND CHINA AND
FULLY DISSIPATING. GLOBAL DETERMINISTIC MODELS, GFS AND ECMWF,
INDICATE THE REMNANT CIRCULATION IS NO LONGER CLOSED AND WILL BE
COMPLETELY GONE WITHIN 12 HOURS. THIS IS THE FINAL WARNING ON THIS
SYSTEM BY THE JOINT TYPHOON WRNCEN PEARL HARBOR HI. THE SYSTEM WILL
BE CLOSELY MONITORED FOR SIGNS OF REGENERATION. MINIMUM CENTRAL
PRESSURE AT 251800Z IS 999 MB. MAXIMUM SIGNIFICANT WAVE HEIGHT AT
251800Z IS 12 FEET.

UPDATES.//
